records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2024, the Company had $0.7 billion unused capacity of its facility under the Programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Included in raw materials and supplies are work in process inventories which were not material as of March 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease is primarily related to lower energy commitments and obligations to purchase agricultural commodity inventories at lower prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities of $508 million and $626 million as of March 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023, respectively, were recorded in accrued expenses and other payables in the consolidated balance sheets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenues recognized in the three months ended March 31, 2024 from the December 31, 2023 contract liabilities were $235 million.
